bolt11_pay.note: Scanned or pasted BOLT 11 invoices are paid through the embedded LND

bolt11_receive.note: Receive screen creates invoices, optionally combined with an on-chain address

bolt12_pay.note: Offers are detected but Pay is disabled on LND; works in LDK mode or with remote CLN

bolt12_receive.note: No offers on LND; only available in LDK Node mode or with remote CLN

offline_receive.note: Only via custodial Cashu-backed ZEUS Pay address; self-custodial Zaplocker being retired

lnurl.note: LNURL-pay, withdraw, channel and auth are all handled

ln_address_receive.note: New embedded addresses are custodial ecash only; NWC type needs remote node

bip353.note: Resolves via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS; offers can't be paid on LND, only on-chain/BOLT 11 fallbacks

mpp.note: MPP toggle with max-parts setting; AMP also offered

keysend.note: Send to a node pubkey; accept-keysend enabled for receiving

choose_peer.note: Open channels to any node URI; LSP defaults to Olympus, custom host configurable

jit_channels.note: Olympus flow LSP wraps invoices with a JIT channel; LSPS1 channel purchase too

splicing.note: No splice capability in Zeus or in the LND RPCs

anchors.note: LND negotiates anchor channels by default; simple taproot channels are optional

local_pathfinding.note: LND routes over its own gossip graph; Express Graph Sync; bimodal/apriori choice

watchtower.note: Client on by default (--wtclient.active); user adds towers under Tools

channel_backup.note: Automatic encrypted static channel backups to the Olympus server; restore offered

taproot.note: Receive screen offers a Taproot (P2TR) address type

multisig.note: Only single-key account types; no multisig code found

hw_signer.note: Import xpub, sign PSBT on another device, scan back via QR (experimental)

coin_control.note: UTXO picker when sending on-chain and when opening channels

tor.note: Built-in Tor only for remote nodes; embedded LND Tor setting has no toggle
